response: Pull request #67 adds the ProtocolIntentClassifier protocol for classifying user intents across 9 categories (including code_generation, pattern_learning, quality_assessment, semantic_analysis) and the ProtocolIntentGraph protocol for intent persistence operations (store_intent, get_session_intents, health_check), along with comprehensive tests and an omnibase-core dependency bump to >=0.9.3, enabling intent-based routing and analysis for the ONEX platform [OMN-1478].
